# Shan Shui Inf (vendored)

Unmodified `index.html` from [LingDong-/shan-shui-inf](https://github.com/LingDong-/shan-shui-inf)
(MIT, © 2018 Lingdong Huang; see `LICENSE`). Vendored so the processing screen's landscape
works offline. It is loaded as a raw string (`?raw`) and adapted at runtime in
`src/components/intake/shanShui.ts`, which runs it in a script-only sandboxed iframe.
